_notes.slurs_with_innocent_senses: Several of these (chink, dyke, retard, gook, wop) are real dictionary words with non-offensive primary senses that ESDB includes. LDNOOBW does not flag them. They are denied here explicitly. The validate.js MUST_NOT_CONTAIN list reads from this deny array so that validation and filtering always agree.
_notes.ldnoobw_gaps: LDNOOBW's English list covers ~400 roots. It misses many slurs that have plausible innocent dictionary senses. This deny list covers the gaps.
_notes.allow_rationale: Use allow only when a word is incorrectly excluded by automated filtering and is clearly appropriate for a family word game.
